name: ModelVariant177_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant177_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the entry is a vertical relative of the French header-131 beam. A spinning tube of fourteen-point rings grows up from the other slot, scrolls its texture and then rises away, while animated sparks fade in and out in a cylinder around its base. A negative command draws a frame; any other command sets the work area up); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French raw images 59520/59530 and 155016/155026 (headers 194/324) build the same source in all PAL regions, with the data in the raw tail bound per image at the same offsets. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
